scope: Independent pre-code review of BATCH-006-REPAIRS; no asset/core/runtime/Git mutation

recommendation: Use one small fixed-material authoring CLI --recipe/--output; no framework, runtime API, encoder changes or model call.

Reuse update_level_sheets.brick_mask and craft_normals.gblur. Do not call authored_height unchanged because it invokes quantized craft. Replay finish, call craft once with quantize_height=False, compose established planes and bounded detail in full precision, then cast final height once to float32.
Retain unchanged canonical RGB bytes and one final scalar package; derive Mid/High using unchanged shared tier CLI. Do not consume prior height, decoded tier height or normal maps.

Retain complete layered recipe and its source/code hashes in final metadata. Prior master JSON, native/raw/prompt and source-bound replay suffice; retiring superseded color/height/map binaries must not break reconstruction.
Preserve old cores and policy source bytes; adapter records their exact canonical paths/hashes and its own hash/current environment.
mandatoryGuards: Before mkdir, bound JSON/input byte and canonical pixel budgets; require exact schema/policy/nativeIdentity/name/edition/nativeDimensions, source master SHA, original and unchanged authoring RGB hashes.

Validate original/generated/prompt/optional-landmarks and exactly known canonical core tool roles/paths/hashes; replay the original finish and compare exact RGB. Reject periodic/layered/revised source packages to prevent applying structural planes twice.
Require native >=8/divisible by4, canonical8x dimensions, raw8x adequacy and same aspect, RGB PNG, finite strict scalar/profile values and known full-precision unregistered source contract.

Layer parameters must be finite non-Boolean numbers: ordered lower<floor<=upper, floor>lower+2micro, micro>=0 bounded, lower>=micro and upper+micro<=1. Avoid silent clipping of otherwise valid-looking malformed planes.
Explicitly preserve bevelPixels old256-reference semantics: sigma=bevelPixels*sqrt(masterWidth*masterHeight)/256. Current1.5 means6 master pixels; do not reinterpret as native pixels.

Bound polygon/region counts, finite2D coordinates in native bounds, >=3 distinct vertices, nonzero area, reject malformed/unknown region shapes; require both substrate and facing pixels. No automatic brightness-driven identity mask.

Refuse existing output paths and symlinks; create only new package files exclusively. Validate and replay all inputs before output creation; recheck recipe/source/tool stability before writing final manifest. Record actual environment and full recipe provenance.
publicChecksRequiredBeforeAcceptance: Valid actual copy: independent finish/plane composition replay, unchanged RGB, one finite float32 scalar, source/recipe/tool hashes and both-tier independent direct-master byte/math replay.

Public CLI refusal before output for source/tool/recipe mismatch, wrong material/dimensions, malformed/nonfinite/degenerate geometry, invalid planes, already-layered/revised input, wrong payload/too-small raw, and existing output. Preserve initial failures rather than relabeling them.

Independent artist must review mask coverage/alignment at both tiers, missed bricks/bleed, intact facing and chip placement, tile edges/corners, normals and opposed-light views. Measure selected mortar-vs-face and facing-vs-substrate samples in decoded height/normal views.
limits: Two-plane algebra guarantees face/substrate depth ordering, not mortar/brick ordering within one substrate mask; existing craft detail is not a semantic mortar guarantee.
Draft NPY is diagnostic only and exactly uses float32 detail staging; proposed full-precision composition differs by tiny final rounding. Explicit final conversion order must be tested.
Wrapped Gaussian respects periodic topology, but does not prove original RGB joins seamless or semantic mask correctness. New material remains on art HOLD until independent review.
